description: This file defines the ServerRequestCreator class, which implements methods to create PSR-7 server request objects from global PHP variables ($_SERVER, $_COOKIE, etc.) and arrays, as well as utility methods for header extraction and URI creation.

classes.name: ServerRequestCreator
classes.description: A final class implementing ServerRequestCreatorInterface for constructing PSR-7 server request objects from PHP globals and provided arrays.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a server request object based on PHP superglobals (__SERVER, __COOKIE, __GET, __POST, __FILES) and input stream.

methods.name: fromArrays
methods.description: Creates a server request object from specified server parameters, headers, cookies, GET, POST, files, and body.

methods.name: getHeadersFromServer
methods.description: Extracts HTTP headers from server environment variables, mimicking Zend's marshalHeadersFromSapi() method.

methods.name: getMethodFromEnv
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP method from the server array, throws if not set.

methods.name: getUriFromEnvWithHTTP
methods.description: Constructs a URI object from server environment, ensuring a scheme is set.

methods.name: normalizeFiles
methods.description: Normalizes the $_FILES array into an array of UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: createUploadedFileFromSpec
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile object from a $_FILES style spec, handling nested arrays.

methods.name: normalizeNestedFileSpec
methods.description: Handles normalization of nested file upload specs into UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: createUriFromArray
methods.description: Constructs a URI object from server environment variables like HTTP_HOST, REQUEST_URI, etc.
